about: v2 P07-D3 residual (Drakoran Watchers armour with Object_Type 0 / AF 0) and P07-D2/D3b model residual (rewards showing the 1.64 'All purpose bag' model 488)

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 6129 'Ariach's Gloves': Hands, Armor Factor 32, Armor Absorb 10 (leather), Dex 6, Hits 12, level 14 (allakhazam-live copy; the Wayback 2003-10-19 copy has the same bonuses and level but says 'Incomplete info given' and shows no AF)
entries.why: Drakoran Watchers reward had Object_Type 0 and AF 0, so it was not armour; the item page gives AF 32 / absorb 10, which is leather (eObjectType.Leather 33, absorb 10 like the other Albion leather gloves); bonuses and level already match

entries.source: Allakhazam item citem 5910 'Stolen Robes of Arawn': Torso, Requires Skill Armor: Cloth, Armor Factor 15, Int 6, Death Servant +2, level 14 (allakhazam-live copy; the Wayback 2003-10-19 copy has the same bonuses and level)
entries.why: Drakoran Watchers reward had Object_Type 0 and AF 0, so it was not armour; the item page gives cloth (eObjectType.Cloth 32) with AF 15 (absorb 0, as other level-15 cloth vests); bonuses and level already match

entries.source: 1.64 client gamedata objects.csv: model 488 = 'All purpose bag', 423 = 'Celtic Reinforced 3 Vest'; the sibling Crace's Desire reward cq_hib_silver_scaled_hauberk uses 428 'Celtic Scaled 3 Vest'
entries.why: the reinforced vest (now Object_Type 37) still showed model 488, the 1.64 client's 'All purpose bag'; 423 is the Celtic reinforced vest of the same tier as its scale sibling (428); look only, no stats change

entries.source: 1.64 client gamedata objects.csv: model 488 = 'All purpose bag', 867 = 'Alb Flex Whip' (no cat-o'-nine-tails model exists in the 1.64 client)
